description: Package declares the retail sale price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes, printed in the prescribed 'Maximum or Max. retail price Rs.../ ₹... inclusive of all taxes' format.
source_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(e); definition of 'retail sale price' at Rule 2(m)

exceptions.modified_requirement: State excise laws govern retail price declaration for alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor instead, in the state where manufactured, where such laws provide for a retail-price declaration.

review_note: Not excluded for food -- unlike clauses (a) and (d), no food-specific carve-out appears anywhere in Rule 6(1)(e) or its provisos. MRP declaration applies to packaged food normally.
